text:
maria (devex): Hey team, hitting a weird onboarding snag with the Python async client when customers set a custom CA + BASE_URL + HTTP proxy for Dedicated. Repro steps below, curious if anyone's seen this

maria (devex): Flow: user sets REDWOOD_BASE_URL to dedicated endpoint + HTTPS_PROXY for corporate proxy + a custom CA bundle via REDWOOD_SSL_CA or system truststore. Calls fail intermittently with TLS handshake errors.

devon (sdk): Ugh. Intermittent how — always on first request or after some idle?

maria (devex): Mostly on first request after process start, sometimes recovered after a retry. Error sample: 

```
ssl.SSLError: [SSL: TLSV1_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA] tlsv1 alert unknown ca (_ssl.c:1123)
```

sam (infra): Do you have a small script we can run? Async event loop + aiohttp session reuse could be involved.

maria (devex): Yep minimal repro: 

```
import os
from redwood import AsyncClient

os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL'] = 'https://dedicated-123.redwood.local'
os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://corp-proxy:3128'
# user has custom CA file at /etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem
os.environ['REDWOOD_SSL_CA'] = '/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem'

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key='x', base_url=os.getenv('REDWOOD_BASE_URL'))
    await c.generate('hello')
```

maria (devex): Logs show aiohttp creating a connector that doesn't pick up our custom CA when proxy is present. When we force sync client it works every time.

devon (sdk): That tracks with a known aiohttp quirk: proxy + custom ssl context needs connector passed explicitly. We probably create default connector inside AsyncClient and forget to attach the custom cafile when proxy is detected.

olivia (eng): Could it also be an ordering problem between env parsing (REDWOOD_SSL_CA) and session pools? If the client builds a pool at import time it might miss env updates during onboarding flows.

maria (devex): Yes, onboarding uses env-based quickstart so import-time things bite us. Customer reported they export vars in the same session then run the sample and fail.

sam (infra): Quick workaround: export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE or point system truststore. For async, pass an explicit ssl.SSLContext to the client constructor: 

```
import ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem')
c = AsyncClient(api_key='x', base_url=..., ssl=ctx)
```

maria (devex): Adding that to the sample app helped. But customers expect env-only onboarding to work. We should fix SDK to respect REDWOOD_SSL_CA + proxy without extra args.

devon (sdk): Agreed. I'll open an issue and a small PR: ensure async client builds connector with ssl context when REDWOOD_SSL_CA present and also when HTTPS_PROXY is set. Also check that base_url parsing doesn't accidentally strip port or scheme when proxy rewriting happens.

devon (sdk): Filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/issues/482 (WIP PR linked there). I'll add a unit test that simulates proxy env and passes cafile to aiohttp.TCPConnector.

maria (devex): Thanks. Can we also add a note in the Dedicated onboarding guide and the quickstart sample app to show the explicit SSLContext workaround until release? New customers are tripping over this in the first hour.

olivia (eng): Yes — I'll send a docs PR for the quickstart repo. Also suggest adding a small health-check snippet the CLI can run to validate the base_url + ca + proxy combo.

maria (devex): Another ask from support: better error message when TLS fails — right now it surfaces raw SSLError. Could the SDK catch common cases and suggest the env/workaround?

devon (sdk): We can detect TLSUnknownCA and raise RedwoodSSLConfigurationError with actionable text: "Custom CA detected but not applied. Try REDWOOD_SSL_CA or pass ssl=SSLContext(...)". I'll include that in the PR.

sam (infra): Ping me on the PR for the connector lifecycle. We need to ensure connector re-use across client instances without leaking contexts (memory/sockets).

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for branch fix/async-proxy-ca (staging). ETA 15m.

maria (devex): Awesome. After the PR lands, I'll update the onboarding quickstart and create a one-click snippet for Customer Success to paste into support threads.

olivia (eng): Also can we add a small typing tweak so AsyncClient accepts either cafile path string via constructor arg `cafile` or `ssl` context with type hints? Some customers rely on typed autocomplete.

devon (sdk): Good point. I'll add overloads in the typing stubs and a short example in docs.

maria (devex): Thanks y'all. Leaving this thread open until the PR is merged and docs updated. :raised_hands:
